conclusions: Canonical controller-created Assets factory has no caller-chosen controller/registry/calldata, custody or configuration authority. create binds the calling Registry, rejects duplicate caller children and uses only fixed child creation. Child validates canonical factory identity and its controller.

ZZZ source identity and custody exit target are one-time preseal. Source/exit matching is now required by seal, so omitted or mismatched setup cannot permanently disable normal exit after sealing. Existing custody validation already rejected zero normal targets: the identified omission was deployment liveness, not an accepted unauthorized ETH exit.

New LP-only fee controller admits only exact current-home Vault receipts in an actual pool currency. Raw donations do not fund fee indices. The raw20unit split preserves80/10/5/5 plus incumbent-only dust settlement and classified reserve release.

New V3 fee rows use strict2word headers/4word bucket rows/5word asset rows, authentic snapshot lineage and exact classified backing/restore. No zero-filled legacy counter fallback or incoming old inbox/remote ledger is accepted. Both ordinary LP and royalty ledgers retain their independent handoff rights.

Fixed external custody remains an explicitly accepted governance trust boundary. Arbitrary recipient control after a valid custody exit is not cryptographic permanence or automatic cross-chain ownership migration.
